body:
Move the JLSE research campaign out of the library. This import contains system profiles and dependency pins, provisioning and Cobalt orchestration, captured evidence and analysis, the paper/outline, milestones, the JLSE development skill, and independent compiler/runtime reproducers.

Evaluation consumes an existing ffmt checkout or an explicitly pinned source revision. A separately pinned portable runner can evaluate historical headers; evaluation receipts identify source, harness, evaluator, commands and hashes without rewriting the runner manifest. The portable ffmt library does not need this repository.

Preserve historical JSON, generated qualification/baseline reports, paper artifacts and reproducers byte for byte. Original library revisions remain accessible through archive/qualified tags in ffmt. The migration ledger records original PR tips and maps final-source header/corpus equivalence to clean library commit `4b8cf257fc68c5b20c0c493e34d1d90269e76fd9`; original `21f9f5e`/`98dba67` captures retain their own identities. Local raw artifacts and installations are preserved through ignored symlinks, with no hardware campaign repeated.

Validation: 13 offline regressions pass, including external runner/source separation, immutable bootstrap, allocation policy, false-pass reporting and symlink-backed evidence export. The provenance verifier checks preserved files, historical configs, header/corpus equivalence, archive refs and raw input hashes; corruption controls reject changed evidence and headers. Remote bootstrap of the pinned modern runner passes. The allocated CPU integration passes all 15 CTest entries, an installed consumer without fmt/Python requirements and sanitized GCC13 Make checks. The evaluation smoke passes two stdout cases and 24 numeric boundary records using archived source `0c2cb76` with the separate clean runner `4b8cf25`. The [validation record](https://github.com/nscottnichols/ffmt-evaluation/blob/evaluation-campaign/docs/provenance/validation.json) preserves commands, hashes, optional skips and identity scope. Paper rebuilds now use fresh ignored output; an eight-page build leaves historical bytes unchanged.

Library replacement: a focused seven-part review stack, [#10](https://github.com/nscottnichols/ffmt/pull/10) → [#11](https://github.com/nscottnichols/ffmt/pull/11) → [#12](https://github.com/nscottnichols/ffmt/pull/12) → [#13](https://github.com/nscottnichols/ffmt/pull/13) → [#14](https://github.com/nscottnichols/ffmt/pull/14) → [#15](https://github.com/nscottnichols/ffmt/pull/15) → [#9](https://github.com/nscottnichols/ffmt/pull/9). The [supplemental mapping and merge guide](https://github.com/nscottnichols/ffmt-evaluation/blob/179e6e59e1a0094ec2e4f56aab11eb568f058055/docs/provenance/review-stack.md) records exact commit and tree equivalence. The original portable split commit remains available through `archive/library-portable-20261022`; existing evaluation source/runner pins remain unchanged. The former mixed campaign branches must not be merged into the library.

Review-stack validation: CPU-only checks cover all seven immutable library prefixes. The first six pass their selected harness, sanitized core/family/range/printf, negative, optional C++23 and benchmark-smoke checks; the final prefix passes all 15 CTest entries, full host conformance and installation. The [original attempt](https://github.com/nscottnichols/ffmt-evaluation/blob/179e6e59e1a0094ec2e4f56aab11eb568f058055/docs/provenance/review-stack-validation/manifest.json) preserves its failure from a generated consumer that directly included internal `core.hpp`. A [consumer-only follow-up](https://github.com/nscottnichols/ffmt-evaluation/blob/179e6e59e1a0094ec2e4f56aab11eb568f058055/docs/provenance/review-stack-validation/consumer-followup/manifest.json) passes using documented public `base.hpp` against the same 17 unchanged installed headers. Exact commands distinguish explicit Make -O0 focused/legacy checks from compiler-default negative optimization. Original logs are losslessly archived with per-file hashes; no library source or hardware campaign changed.
title: Import JLSE evaluation with pinned external ffmt and preserved provenance
